extinctDescription: The species no longer exists in the wild
extinctWildDescription: The species only exists in captivity
criticallyEndangeredDescription: The species has an extremely high risk of extinction in the wild
endangeredDescription: The species has a very high risk of extinction in the wild
vulnerableDescription: The species has a high risk of extinction in the wild
almostThreatenedDescription: The species is not endangered, but could be in the future
insufficientDataDescription: There is not enough information to assess the extinction risk of the species
notRatedDescription: The species has not been evaluated by the IUCN
appendix1Description: All species facing extinction. Trade in specimens of these species is permitted only in exceptional circumstances
appendix2Description: Species not necessarily threatened with extinction, but whose trade must be controlled in order to avoid use incompatible with their survival
appendix3Description: Species that are protected in at least one country, which has asked for assistance from other CITES Parties in controlling trade in the species
